sources.title: Scarab Deluxe — Basic Audio
sources.excerpt:
Scarab Deluxe — Basic Audio Contact Store About Menu Basic Audio Contact Store About Pedal colors are subject to change. I am a one man shop, please be patient. I will get your order to you as soon as I can. ← Back to Store Scarab Deluxe Scarab Deluxe from $210.00 A silicon Tonebender MKII type circuit with Variable low frequency input (FAT), Tone and Bias knobs. Flexible and tight. Country: Select Country USA Canada Europe, Asia, Australia USA Canada Europe, Asia, Australia Quantity: Add To Cart All pedals use a center negative 9v DC jack and have a battery snap.
- **Archive parent:** Scarab Deluxe
- **Builder:** Basic Audio
- **Catalog type:** Fuzz
- **Identity:** Silicon Tone Bender MkII-type fuzz expanded from the earlier Scarab with external Bias and Fat controls. [1][2]

- **LEVEL**
- **TONE**
- **FUZZ**
- **BIAS**
- **FAT** [1]
FAT changes the amount of low-frequency content feeding the saturation stages.

- **Primary reference:** Tone Bender MkII.
- Basic Audio explicitly describes Scarab Deluxe as a silicon Tone Bender MkII-type circuit. [1]

- **Technology:** Silicon.
- An independent Guitar Pedal X report identifies **4 × BC549B** in its documented Scarab Deluxe reference. This is retained as attributed independent evidence, not as a universal factory BOM. [3]
- Exact gain grading is not documented.

- Exact clipping-device type and part number are not documented in the reviewed reliable sources.

- **9V center-negative** operation with battery support. [1]

- **Scarab:** Earlier three-knob form.
- **Scarab Deluxe:** Adds external **Bias** and **Fat** controls. [1][2]
- The archive keeps the two names distinct.

Scarab Deluxe spans tighter, potentially gated silicon fuzz into thicker sustained sounds. Bias shifts the operating point, while Fat changes the amount of low-frequency material entering the fuzz stages. [1]

- **Identity:** High
- **Tone Bender MkII lineage:** High
- **Silicon technology:** High
- **Bias/Fat additions:** High
- **4 × BC549B observation:** Medium, independent attributed evidence
- **Exact diode:** Unknown

Basic Audio's Scarab Deluxe documentation was checked against Effects Database and the independent Guitar Pedal X component report. The archive deliberately labels the BC549B information as an independent observation rather than a manufacturer-published BOM. [1][2][3]

1. Basic Audio — Scarab Deluxe: https://www.basicaudio.net/store-1/5einpey75gjgckjedkvbsb3vnya-y3hb9-97e3s-cnzrr-ksfg5-kba26-6jkg6
2. Effects Database — Scarab Deluxe: https://www.effectsdatabase.com/model/basicaudio/scarab/deluxe
3. Guitar Pedal X — Tone Bender MkII alternatives: https://www.guitarpedalx.com/news/gpx-blog/high-quality-near-equivalent-alternatives-to-the-boss-tb-2w-tone-bender-mkii-waza-craft-fuzz

- **Exact pedal photograph:** Existing exact-model Stang Guitars photograph.
- **Source:** https://stangguitars.com/
